storylines.title: US-Ukraine rift over Starlink and strikes
storylines.summary: Trump waived new Russia sanctions, which Zelenskyy calls a reward for Putin, and GOP lawmakers criticized the move. Zelenskyy says Starlink limits persist as Russia hits Ukraine's energy sector; senators press the Pentagon.

events.text: Zelenskyy calls the sanctions waiver a 'reward' for Putin; Sen. Tillis calls it 'beyond irresponsible.'
Zelenskyy says Starlink limits in Ukraine are a 'planned operation' that hamper drone interception.
Russian strikes kill at least eight and injure nearly 60 across Ukraine.
Trump signs an order waiving Russia sanctions and tariffs mandated by a new law, a week after a diesel deal with Putin.
Italy's defense minister tells the BBC the US is wrong to restrict Ukraine support.
Four Republican senators join Democrats pressing the Pentagon on whether it ordered Ukraine Starlink restrictions.
Trump says neither he nor Musk caused the Starlink slowdown and he doesn't know who ordered the Starshield throttle.
Ukraine's Operation Vivaldi retakes more territory in Donetsk, with Starlink playing a key role, the BBC reports.
Zelenskyy says Starlink access not fully restored; reports say the White House ordered the limit; EU leaders rally behind Kyiv.
Trump calls Ukraine's latest strikes a 'disgrace' and says Zelenskyy is harder to work with than Putin.

storylines.title: AI debt worries and market selloff
storylines.summary: Big Tech, chip and bank stocks are sliding as credit markets question the AI debt buildup. Tech had its worst week in 18 months, while junk-bond buyers are shunning AI financing after CoreWeave's troubles.

events.text: Junk bond buyers freeze out tech startups as CoreWeave's pain raises questions over AI financing.
S&P 500 tech sector has its worst week in 18 months while the average stock gains.
Software and semiconductor stocks fall together Friday on AI and interest-rate fears.
Anthropic offers Blackstone a double-digit yield on chip financing, complicating its investment-grade goal.
Big Tech posts its biggest weekly drop since 'liberation day'; CoreWeave falls 25% for the week as investors buy Treasuries.
Chip stocks near longest losing run since 2008; big bank shares on worst weekly streak since 2008.

storylines.title: Fed under Warsh weighs further hikes
storylines.summary: After a September hike, the Fed under Chairman Kevin Warsh is expected to hold Oct. 28, though MarketWatch says it is a closer call than markets think, given inflation and communication changes.

events.text: MarketWatch says the October decision is a closer call than markets think, weighing arguments against a hike.
Warsh says the economy has performed largely as expected since the September hike; markets expect a hold.

storylines.title: 2026 midterm elections
storylines.summary: Democrats lead in fundraising and forecast shifts, Republicans lean on Musk money, and legal fights over voter rolls continue. Lawmakers report threatening letters as early voting nears, and Trump's travel favors red states.

events.text: Rep. Hillary Scholten says she got a threatening letter claiming to be from DSA, joining other lawmakers.
NPR says Trump's midterm travel includes many red states; Politico says some GOP candidates avoid featuring him.
Trump says California election officials who count noncitizen ballots will go to jail; DOJ already sued the state.
More lawmakers report suspicious mailings after earlier letters with unknown substances reached election offices.
At a Georgia rally Trump repeats a claim Ossoff's election was illegitimate; the Guardian calls it false.
Ocasio-Cortez gives $1 million to Abdul El-Sayed's Michigan Senate bid; Trump rallies in Georgia for Mike Collins.
Cook Political Report moves 11 House races toward Democrats; Talarico's haul tops Senate GOP rivals.
Musk gave a record $158 million to the Senate Leadership Fund.

storylines.title: US-Iran war and oil prices
storylines.summary: After nine months of war, Brent crude reached $110. Two vessels have hit mines in Hormuz this week and both the US and Iran claim control. Vance has hinted at disagreement with Trump over the war.

events.text: US and Iran both claim control of Hormuz as two vessels are struck by naval mines this week.
Vance publicly hints at disagreement with Trump over the Iran war, per the Washington Examiner.
IRGC says an oil supertanker hit a naval mine and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz.
CENTCOM commander says the US naval blockade has cost Iran about $25 billion in oil revenue.
Brent crude hits $110 for the first time since May amid reports Saudi-led forces intercepted missiles aimed at energy hubs.
CENTCOM's Adm. Brad Cooper says Iran-backed militias are sending money to the IRGC after nine months of war.
